tools.name: search_law
tools.description: Find articles of Lithuanian codes, laws and Government-approved rules (unofficial mirror of e-tar.lt). Use a reference ("DK 52", "CK 6.228¹", "KET 52") or Lithuanian words ("kasmetinės atostogos"). Returns articles with their URL and whether their text applies today.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: The text of one article (or point) as published by the Seimas Chancellery, unchanged, with its status today (Galioja šiandien / Įsigalios D / Gali būti pasenęs / Neaišku, ar galioja / Neteko galios), until when that label is certain, amending acts, the future wording if adopted, defined terms used,

tools.name: list_acts
tools.description: Every act on the site: its key, citation form, name, number of articles and how many apply today.

tools.name: get_act_contents
tools.description: The articles of one act in order (number, title, chapter, status), paged.

tools.name: upcoming_changes
tools.description: Articles whose text or status changes in the next days (adopted amendments with a date).
